purpose: Test whether the first external same-request conventional fallback tail is caused by not priming that branch in the controller process.

intervention.off: 20 clean NeuralRx IPC warmups and one noisy NeuralRx IPC warmup; no conventional execution before timed releases
intervention.on: same NeuralRx warmups plus 20 clean conventional warmups and one noisy conventional warmup

interpretation_limit: A passing ABBA result supports branch-specific cold-start causality on this hardware; it does not establish a worst-case service-time bound for subsequent fallbacks.
